name: Advanced Topics in Power Electronics
description: Newer generation wide band gap power electronic devices like SiC and GaN devices- properties, advantages and uses in power converters, challenges. Introduction to advanced power electronic converters used in dc-dc and ac-dc applications (for example, dual active bridge converters, Vienna rectifiers, partial power converters etc). Zero-current and zero-voltage switching techniques in dc-dc and dc-ac applications. Resonant/quasi-resonant converters. Auxiliary transition networks. Design of power electronic converters- switch selection, passive component design, thermal management, system design. Latest developments and trends in power electronics in traditional and upcoming applications like electric traction, electric ship, electric aircraft, aerospace, etc.
